method: Every item reviewed by question form and option set. Routing is a category that selects the next code path: the options are tools, handlers, people to page, or the action an agent takes next. SDE recovers a field the text states. Verification checks an artifact or claim against requirements. Classification keeps outcomes, statuses and intent labels.
